purpose: Teach: モットー/貸与/累計/問屋/立ち寄り/小売り/衣料/言明

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員研修で当社のモットーを再確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's use the staff training session to reaffirm our company values.
lines.style: Professional, measured tone. Direct but not unkind. Opens with quiet authority — this is what we're here to do. Steady pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社用車の貸与申請が増えました
lines.en: Yes — we've been seeing more applications for company vehicle loans.
lines.style: Attentive, responsive. Slight lean-in quality — offering information that feeds the conversation naturally. Warm professionalism, no flourish.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 累計の来客数を集計しましょう
lines.en: Let's compile the cumulative customer numbers.
lines.style: Clear directive, methodical. Brief pause after the opening word. Even tone throughout — this is practical work to be done together, not a demand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。問屋への発注頻度を見直しました
lines.en: Yes — I reviewed the ordering frequency with our wholesalers.
lines.style: Steady report. Light emphasis on the completed action. Reliable in delivery — not apologetic, not over-eager, just informing as promised.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お取引先に立ち寄りで顔を出しましょう
lines.en: Let's make a point to stop by and see our business partners in person.
lines.style: Gentle directive with warmth underneath. Slight soft attack on the opening. Even, conversational pace — this is relationship-building, not a chore.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。小売り価格の改定をお願いしました
lines.en: Yes — I've asked them to implement the retail price revisions.
lines.style: Steady, confirming tone. Brief pause on the verb. Even delivery — completing the action that was asked of him, nothing more to prove.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 衣料部門の在庫管理を強化しましょう
lines.en: Let's strengthen our inventory management in the clothing department.
lines.style: Clear, purposeful direction. Slight weight on the action verb. Even tempo, calm authority — this matters and we're doing it together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社の方針を正式に言明する文書を準備中です
lines.en: Yes — I'm preparing a formal policy statement document for the company.
lines.style: Closing tone, slight sense of completion. Steady throughout. Light emphasis on 'formal' — this is the final piece coming into place. Satisfied without excess.
